name: capital_gain_core
hypothesis: Rectified multi-stage pipeline transforming capital-gain (-63). Capital-gain fans through a depth-3 ReLU cascade (3446->4739->2129 plus direct) converging on hub 655, read out to the output via four opposing-sign weights (655/313 vs 5102/6421). Over the observed range of capital-gain the seven neurons collapse to a SINGLE-KNOT threshold - flat for the ~90% with zero capital-gain, one knot, then a linear ramp - i.e. functionally a single ReLU (see Figure: capgain transfer curve, constant slope after one knot across the full data range). The cascade's earlier inner knots (z~-0.42, z~-0.03) fall below the data floor or are masked by the output unit's clipping, and the four readouts all bend at the same threshold, so they set slope and offset but add NO further knots. The depth-3 structure therefore exceeds the single threshold it produces over the data - excess structure, the same phenomenon as the fused native-country terms below. (Claim bounded to the observed data range; depth may act on out-of-range capital-gain.) Also absorbs native-country one-hots -73/-81/-82/-89/-94, which carry large weights but are shown inert by ablation (test AUC 0.9055->0.9054 on the full split; memorisation on tiny support).

name: bump_marital_status_3
hypothesis: marital-status:3 contributes both a small direct linear term (via idn_o32) and a rectified gate (4092), together a category-specific offset to the output.

name: bump_occupation_11
hypothesis: occupation:11 contributes a direct linear term (idn_o39) plus a rectified gate (5692); a category-specific offset.

name: bump_native_country_11_33
hypothesis: A rectified gate (3188) combining native-country:11 (-67, strong negative weight) and native-country:33 (-91), plus -91's direct linear term (idn_o91); a country-specific offset.

name: bump_native_country_20
hypothesis: native-country:20 contributes a direct linear term (idn_o77) plus a rectified gate (10528); a country-specific offset.

name: bump_occupation_2
hypothesis: occupation:2 contributes a near-zero direct term (idn_o43) plus a rectified gate (10591, large negative bias so rarely active); a mostly-inactive category offset.

name: bump_native_country_34
hypothesis: native-country:34 contributes a direct linear term (idn_o92) plus a rectified gate (10902); a country-specific offset.

name: bump_native_country_26
hypothesis: native-country:26 (-84) passes through a single ReLU gate (354, large positive bias so almost always active) to the output; effectively a near-linear category offset.

name: linear_backbone
hypothesis: Sparse linear backbone: 40 features each contribute a single weighted term summed at lin_agg. Dominant terms marital-status:2 (-31, -1.15), education-num (-28, -0.80), workclass:0 (-2, +0.66), relationship:1 (-52, -0.43), hours-per-week (-65, -0.35), sex (-62, -0.33). Carries most of the model's predictive mass (top SHAP).

name: unused_inputs
hypothesis: The 53 input features the evolved network never connected. No edges; contribute nothing. Implicit feature selection by omission.

name: full_model
hypothesis: Root: output = ReLU(0.527 + linear_backbone(lin_agg) + capital_gain_core readouts(655,313,5102,6421) + 7 category bumps). Additive combination of one linear part and several rectified parts. Top-level composition covering the whole genome.
